title: Gemini API
description: Gemini API allows developers to build generative AI applications using Gemini models. Built ground-up to be multimodal - can understand text, images, audio, video, and code.
non_obvious_insight: The Gemini API isn't just an LLM API. It's a multimodal reasoning engine. Every generateContent call is a signal about what combination of modalities, safety settings, and model capabilities produce the best output for a given task. The local cache of responses enables offline analysis of model behavior, response quality comparison, and prompt engineering iteration without repeated API calls.
target_audience: AI/ML engineers building generative AI applications
auto_generated_workflow_commands: sync - Pull model metadata and cache responses locally
search - FTS5 search across cached data
sql - Direct SQL queries on local store
analytics - Usage patterns and token consumption
